baseline_models.focus_anchor: مكر الليل والنهار and تأمروننا أن نكفر
baseline_models.mechanism: The night/day merism makes elite command a continuous environment rather than a single persuasion event: obligation is renewed across darkness and daylight until covering the truth becomes routine.

activation_trace.role: Night as darkness opposed to day supplies one half of an enclosing temporal cycle.
Day as opened daylight completes the cycle and makes the pressure continuous.
Command as request plus obligation turns temporal repetition into directed social pressure.
Covering the truth names both the commanded outcome and the class later bound by it.

changed_reading.before: The leaders occasionally persuaded the followers to disbelieve.
changed_reading.after: The leaders maintained a round-the-clock command environment that normalized concealment of truth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الذين استضعفوا للذين استكبروا and نجعل له أندادا
baseline_models.mechanism: A hierarchy of weakness and self-magnifying rank acts through command to assign opposing peers to God; the rivals are socially made, not merely passively encountered.

activation_trace.role: Lack of strength supplies the subordinate pole of the command relation.
Elevated rank and leadership supply the socially dominant pole.
Authority and its holder make the leaders' rank operational through command.
Making as causing a thing to assume a state frames rivalhood as an imposed construction.
An opposing peer supplies the status that the hierarchy orders its followers to fabricate.

changed_reading.before: The followers adopted an already available theological error.
changed_reading.after: A ranked social apparatus actively manufactured and enforced rival status for God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أسروا الندامة لما رأوا العذاب and الأغلال في أعناق
baseline_models.mechanism: The scene moves from hidden interior affect through sight to public bodily restraint: regret cannot remain inward once punishment is seen, and the concealed condition is answered by a visible collaring of the body.

activation_trace.role: Hiding something inward supplies the concealed affective state.
Grief over an irretrievable matter gives the hidden state its backward-looking force.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the disclosure threshold that activates regret.
Painful punishment is the newly visible object that makes concealment futile.
A collar that binds an organ converts inward moral captivity into explicit bodily restraint.
The neck as the bodily site of a collar makes the consequence publicly legible.

changed_reading.before: Concealed remorse and neck-chains are two adjacent consequences.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a conversion of hidden remorse into visible, embodied restraint after sight removes denial.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: هل يجزون إلا ما كانوا يعملون
baseline_models.mechanism: The restrictive closing question returns consequence to historically enacted, intentional work. The followers' causal accusation remains audible, but it cannot transfer their own performed action wholly onto the commanders.

activation_trace.role: Matching an act with its recompense supplies the deed-indexed return.
Occurrence and presence in past time make the work a sustained history rather than a last-minute claim.
Intentional action identifies the accountable unit that survives the blame exchange.

changed_reading.before: The powerful alone caused the weak party's error.
changed_reading.after: Elite causation is named without erasing the followers' intentional participation, because return is indexed to enacted work.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier ordered work softens iron and joins measured links into protective craft; the focus joins command, work, and links again, but as captivity. The surah therefore contrasts disciplined making that protects with sustained social making that culminates in fetters.

activation_trace.role: Iron and resistant solidity supply the material later evoked by penal links.
Piercing and joining rings or leather supplies the constructive topology of protective linkage.
Repeated intentional work makes the protective artifact a product of accountable practice.
Binding command supplies a prior command-work-punishment sequence for comparison.
The collaring fetter inverts linked craft from bodily protection into bodily capture.
Intentional work closes the inversion by evaluating what each pattern of making produced.

structural_cues: 34:10-11 moves from softened iron to measured linking and repeats the command to work.
34:12 places commanded labor beside threatened punishment; 34:33 again places command, work, and linked restraint in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies iron, measured linkage, commanded work, and focus fetters; I infer a material inversion, not identity of artisans or material. The live alternative is that armor and chains are independent images joined only by the reader.

changed_reading.before: The neck-fetters are a generic punishment appended to the debate.
changed_reading.after: The fetters answer an earlier craft of protective links: ordered work can build protection, while corrupt ordered practice ripens into captivity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Safe night/day movement is later converted into requested distance, fragmentation, and following, while the followed tempter is denied coercive authority. This keeps the focus's pervasive manipulation but distinguishes environmental pressure from irresistible causation.

activation_trace.role: Activity by night supplies a prior benign use of the same temporal span as safe movement.
The bounded daytime paired with nights completes the earlier safe travel cycle.
Allegiance and succession identify following as the followers' enacted link in the causal chain.
Power and authority, explicitly denied in the source construction, limit the influencer's causal sovereignty.
Obligating command preserves the reality of elite pressure within the revised model.
Intentional work preserves follower agency despite the pervasive command environment.

structural_cues: 34:18 pairs safe travel by nights and days; 34:19 asks that distances be increased and ends in fragmentation.
34:20 states that they followed, while 34:21 states that the influencer had no سلطان over them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies round-the-clock movement, following, and denied authority; I infer an analogy between that influence and elite command, so pressure may be pervasive without being irresistible. The live alternative is that 34:21's denial applies only to Iblis and cannot be transferred fully to human elites.

changed_reading.before: Night/day command makes the followers chiefly passive products of coercion.
changed_reading.after: The manipulation is pervasive and causally real, but following is still an enacted allegiance; the ayah holds influence and personal work together.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding tests dismantle every transfer mechanism assigned to rivals: ownership, share, assistance, intercession, patronage, benefit, and harm. The focus's making of rivals is therefore construction of a dependency network whose promised transfers all fail at judgment.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and disposal supply the first capacity explicitly denied to alleged rivals.
Participation and shared stake supply the partnership relation explicitly denied.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the promised outcome that intermediation cannot independently deliver.
An intercessor joining another supplies the transfer mechanism restricted by permission.
Love, support, and patronage supply the allegiance that the supposed objects of worship disown.
Harm opposed to benefit completes the explicit collapse of one party's control for another.
Causing a thing to assume a state frames this failed dependency network as manufactured.
The opposing peer names the fabricated node to which those powers were assigned.

structural_cues: 34:22 denies the alleged deities ownership, share, and assistance; 34:23 restricts intercession.
34:40-42 has worshipped figures disown the relation and states that no party owns benefit or harm for another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed supernatural intermediation and the focus supplies human command and rival-making; I infer a shared dependency architecture, not identity between human elites and worshipped beings. The live alternative is to keep the two domains separate.

changed_reading.before: Making rivals is only a wrong proposition about God's peers.
changed_reading.after: Making rivals builds a patronage and transfer network; judgment exposes every assigned power and every attempted transfer of rescue or blame as unavailable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Separate questioning over crimes and works leads to gathering and truth-judgment; speech then returns between the parties as each identifies or denies causation. The focus's final restriction to performed work functions as a ruling against wholesale transfer of liability.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal questioning supplies the separation of one party's crimes from the other's works.
Gathering dispersed parties supplies the common forum in which competing accounts meet.
Opening a closure by judgment supplies the forensic decision promised for the gathered parties.
Returning an answer or speech makes the accusation a recursive exchange rather than settled causation.
Turning away or turning another away names the causal act the leaders contest.
Matching deeds with recompense supplies the ruling criterion after testimony.
Intentional action fixes the nontransferable unit of liability without silencing causal evidence.

structural_cues: 34:25 distinguishes our crimes from your works, and 34:26 promises gathering followed by judgment in truth.
34:31-33 alternates accusation, denial, counter-accusation, and then closes with the restrictive recompense question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a question-gather-judge sequence and returned testimony; I infer that the blame exchange attempts to relocate liability. The live alternative is that the scene is polemical dialogue rather than a formal forensic procedure.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports a quarrel over who caused disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The quarrel is failed liability transfer: coercive mechanisms enter evidence, but recompense remains matched to each party's intentional work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The gathering root carries a branch image of a fetter joining hands to neck, while the promised gathering immediately precedes truth-judgment and the focus later places fetters at necks. Judicial collection is thus materially echoed as bodily binding.

activation_trace.role: A fetter joining hands to the neck supplies a latent material image inside judicial gathering.
Judicial opening fixes the gathering-fetter image within a judgment mechanism.
The explicit collaring fetter realizes the latent restraint image at the focus.
The literal neck completes the unusually exact hand-to-neck branch echo.

structural_cues: 34:26 says God will gather between the parties and then judge between them; 34:31-33 presents those parties stopped, disputing, and finally neck-bound.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a hand-to-neck fetter branch for gathering, a judgment sequence, and literal focus neck-fetters; I infer a deliberate material echo. The live alternative is that يجمع in 34:26 means ordinary gathering and the fetter branch is only associative.

changed_reading.before: Gathering for judgment and the later chains are independent actions.
changed_reading.after: The chains embody judicial gathering: parties who try to scatter liability are collected into an inescapable bodily account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus recurrence of affluent rejecters who boast in numerical and financial superiority turns the arrogant commanders into a reproducible social class. Their continuous command protects a material status system that presents abundance as immunity.

activation_trace.role: Expansive luxury that releases its possessor from restraint supplies the class habit behind rejection.
Competing for superiority by number makes social rank a claimed proof of security.
Acquiring and multiplying wealth supplies the material base of that superiority claim.
High rank and leadership connect the focus commanders to the affluent opinion-setting class.
Authority and its holder convert material rank into directive social power.

structural_cues: 34:34 generalizes the pattern to every settlement's affluent rejecters.
34:35 bases their confidence against punishment on greater wealth and children; 34:36-37 denies that these possessions establish nearness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring affluent rejection, abundance boasts, and focus rank-command; I infer a class mechanism behind the focus leaders. The live alternative is that the arrogant group need not be coextensive with the affluent rejecters.

changed_reading.before: The arrogant commanders are individuals with a proud temperament.
changed_reading.after: They are a recurring materially advantaged class whose continuous messaging reproduces disbelief and imagined immunity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus shows agency captured inside weak/strong blocs and repeated command; the later procedure breaks the crowd into pairs and individuals who stand and think. Deliberative rescaling becomes a counter-mechanism to hierarchical influence.

activation_trace.role: Resolute rising toward a matter supplies the first act of recovered agency.
Joining one to one as two supplies a scale small enough for mutual checking.
The solitary individual supplies separation from bloc pressure.
The heart's repeated consideration supplies deliberation in place of commanded repetition.
Social weakness identifies the agency deficit that the later procedure counters.
Obligating command identifies the external directive displaced by reflection.
Intentional work explains why recovering deliberation matters for final accountability.

structural_cues: 34:46 prescribes standing for God, first two by two and individually, and only then sustained reflection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bloc-based accusation at the focus and pair/individual reflection later; I infer that the latter is an anti-capture procedure. The live alternative is that 34:46 addresses inquiry generally rather than the followers' social dependence specifically.

changed_reading.before: The weak party's only available agency is compliance with or retrospective accusation of leaders.
changed_reading.after: The surah also exposes a route out of captured agency: leave the mass hierarchy, deliberate in pairs or alone, and own the work that follows.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's sight-regret-fetter sequence becomes spatially explicit at the surah's close: escape is missed, seizure comes from near, late belief cannot be reached from far, and a barrier blocks desire. The chain is closure of access, not pain alone.

activation_trace.role: Failure of reaching or apprehending supplies the loss of escape.
Capture and arrest supply the near seizure that replaces imagined distance.
Reaching by extension supplies the action that has become impossible from afar.
A separating barrier supplies the final closure between persons and desired recovery.
Following and accompaniment show that factional affiliation repeats rather than removes the fate.
Sight supplies the late recognition point from which regret begins.
Regret for what is irretrievable supplies the affect of missed access.
The collaring fetter gives bodily form to the closure of escape and reach.

structural_cues: 34:51-52 contrasts seizure from a near place with an impossible attempt to reach belief from a far place.
34:53 repeats prior disbelief and distant projection; 34:54 places a barrier between them and what they desire and aligns them with their factions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near capture, failed reach, distance, and a barrier after the focus fetters; I infer a spatial exposition of those fetters. The live alternative is that the closing images independently express finality without specifically unpacking the chains.

changed_reading.before: The chains punish bodies after remorse appears.
changed_reading.after: The chains materialize irreversible closure: once punishment is seen, escape, late belief, desired return, and rescue by one's faction are all out of reach.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the immediate remorse scene readily supports inward concealment; it remains valid because the focus inventory explicitly carries an أسر branch of making something manifest at the same anchor. Downstream prose should preserve it only as a branch-level counter-reading, not replace the strong concealment reading.

activation_trace.role: The branch in which أسر displays what is spoken supplies a possible public disclosure of remorse.
Regret over an irretrievable matter supplies the content that may be disclosed rather than hidden.
Seeing punishment supplies the public threshold that could force remorse into expression.

changed_reading.before: They silently hide remorse when punishment becomes visible.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical alternative, sight may make them disclose or avow the remorse that the stronger reading keeps inward.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the surface senses are plotting and recompense, while watering and harvest come from secondary mapped images. It remains anchored in focus مكر, night/day repetition, work, and the split جزى inventory, with the surah's garden-flood-produce sequence providing a material bridge. Downstream prose should render it only as an agricultural mechanism, never as a lexical replacement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مكر الليل والنهار and هل يجزون إلا ما كانوا يعملون

activation_trace.role: Watering hard ground or crops supplies a cultivation image for sustained social plotting.
Repeated activity by night supplies one interval of continual tending.
Flowing floodwater supplies the whole-surah material reversal from nurture to destructive excess.
The yield of tree or crop supplies the changed produce that follows corrupted cultivation.
Intentional work supplies the repeated human tending from which the moral crop grows.
The time of cutting or harvest supplies an exploratory reaping endpoint for matured work.

changed_reading.before: A continuous conspiracy causes disbelief and is later recompensed.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, continuous command cultivates allegiance like a crop; intentional work tends it, corrupted produce emerges, and judgment arrives as its cutting time.

strongest_changes: The night/day command remains pervasive, but the following-without-authority sequence preserves distributed agency and explains the closing return to intentional work.
The dispute becomes a forensic failure to transfer liability: causal pressure is admitted as evidence while recompense stays deed-indexed.
Earlier protective link-work and the gathering root's hand-to-neck fetter image make the focus chains a material form of corrupted work and judicial collection.
The final near/far sequence turns remorse and chains into irreversible loss of escape, reach, desired return, and factional rescue.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made social hierarchy, material craft, legal gathering, spatial closure, and individual deliberation coexist without collapsing them; the unusually exact جمع hand-to-neck branch and the contained cultivation-harvest branch chain were the most distinctive activations.
remaining_uncertainties: The denial of سلطان in 34:21 directly concerns Iblis, so its transfer to human elite influence remains analogical.
The armor-chain and judicial-gathering/fetter links may be deliberate material echoes or reader-supplied branch associations.
أسروا supports a strong concealment model and a packet-backed disclosure outlier; the response does not disambiguate them.
The cultivation-harvest reading is mechanistically coherent but too branch-distant to use as an unqualified lexical rendering.
